newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Montoro - regulated pricing won't exceed CPI.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Montoro - regulated pricing won't exceed CPI.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday price rises under government regulation would not exceed consumer price inflation this year or next.
Speaking to a congressional committee, Montoro said, "Regulated prices will not grow above CPI this year or next."
Montoro said the downtrend in inflation was satisfactory adding he was confident prices would continue to decline in coming months.

On Tuesday, Spanish Industry Minister Josep Pique said the government would require electric, natural gas and fuel derivatives companies to reduce prices for domestic consumption and for small and medium-sized businesses, according to local press reports.
Electricity tariffs would fall by about one percent for private homes from next year, and by about five percent for small- and medium-sized companies.
Earlier this month, the government announced a freeze on distribution costs of butane and propane gas cannisters.
